phase_detail: CBA still in force; owners expected to lock out players when it expires
headline: The World Series is over and the sides remain far apart on a salary cap, so a lockout on Dec. 2 is widely expected.
latest: Free agency opened with no bargaining sessions scheduled, and the sides remain apart on the owners' salary cap proposal. Clubs face the qualifying offer deadline today, before any lockout.
next_milestone: Qualifying offer and contract option deadline
